parts.label: a
parts.title: I / Q components
parts.question: Write down the inphase and quadrature components of the complex equivalent baseband signal.
parts.reason: Complex signal မှာ j မပါတဲ့ term က I၊ j နဲ့မြှောက်ထားတဲ့ coefficient က Q ဖြစ်လို့ ခွဲတာပါ။

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>j</mi><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{BB}(t)=x_{BB,I}(t)+j x_{BB,Q}(t)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>si</mo><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{x_{BB,I}(t)=4\,\operatorname{si}\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{T}\right)}</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>si</mo><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{x_{BB,Q}(t)=\operatorname{si}\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{2T}\right)}</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: b
parts.title: Baseband Fourier transform
parts.question: Calculate the spectrum X_BB(f), separately showing its real and imaginary parts.
parts.reason: Time-domain sinc ကို Frequency-domain rectangle ပြောင်းဖို့ Fourier transform pair ကို သုံးတာပါ။

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>si</mo><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>⇔</mo><mi>T</mi><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{si}\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{T}\right) \Longleftrightarrow  T\,\operatorname{rect}(Tf)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">X_{BB,I}(f)=4T\,\operatorname{rect}(Tf)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">X_{BB,Q}(f)=2T\,\operatorname{rect}(2Tf)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{X_{BB}(f)=4T\,\operatorname{rect}(Tf)+j2T\,\operatorname{rect}(2Tf)}</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: d
parts.title: Baseband energy
parts.question: Determine the energy of the complex equivalent baseband signal.
parts.reason: Parseval theorem သုံးရင် Energy ကို spectrum ရဲ့ |height|² × width နဲ့ တိုက်ရိုက်တွက်လို့ရပါတယ်။

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>E</mi><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub></msub><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo>∫</mo><mrow><mi>−</mi><mi>∞</mi></mrow><mi>∞</mi></msubsup><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mi>d</mi><mi>f</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">E_{x_{BB}}=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}|X_{BB}(f)|^2\,df</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">= (4T)^2\frac1T+(2T)^2\frac1{2T}</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: e
parts.title: Quadrature modulation
parts.question: Calculate the bandpass signal x(t) at the quadrature modulator output.
parts.reason: I signal ကို cosine carrier နဲ့၊ Q signal ကို negative sine carrier နဲ့ ပေါင်းပြီး real bandpass signal ထုတ်တာပါ။

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>sin</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x(t)=\sqrt2\,x_{BB,I}(t)\cos(2\pi f_ct)-\sqrt2\,x_{BB,Q}(t)\sin(2\pi f_ct)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>si</mo><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mi>T</mi></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mspace width="0.167em"></mspace><mo>si</mo><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>sin</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{x(t)=4\sqrt2\,\operatorname{si}\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{T}\right)\cos(2\pi f_ct)-\sqrt2\,\operatorname{si}\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{2T}\right)\sin(2\pi f_ct)}</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: f
parts.title: Bandpass Fourier spectrum
parts.question: Determine the spectrum X(f) of the bandpass signal.
parts.reason: Carrier နဲ့မြှောက်တာက spectrum ကို +fc နဲ့ −fc ဆီ shift လုပ်ပေးပါတယ်။

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>X</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">X(f)=\frac1{\sqrt2}[X_{BB,I}(f-f_c)+X_{BB,I}(f+f_c)]</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mspace width="2.0em"></mspace><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>j</mi><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt></mfrac><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>X</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\qquad+\frac{j}{\sqrt2}[X_{BB,Q}(f-f_c)-X_{BB,Q}(f+f_c)]</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><mi>X</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>j</mi><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mo>rect</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{X(f)=2\sqrt2T[\operatorname{rect}(T(f-f_c))+\operatorname{rect}(T(f+f_c))]+j\sqrt2T[\operatorname{rect}(2T(f-f_c))-\operatorname{rect}(2T(f+f_c))]}</annotation></semantics></math>

parts.label: i

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>h</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mo>si</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">h(t)=2\operatorname{si}^2\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{4T}\right)\cos(2\pi f_ct)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>Re</mo><mo stretchy="false" form="prefix">{</mo><mi>R</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false" form="postfix">}</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><msup><mi>T</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><mi>Λ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>Λ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\operatorname{Re}\{R(f)\}=8\sqrt2T^2[\Lambda(4T(f-f_c))+\Lambda(4T(f+f_c))]</annotation></semantics></math>

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>r</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>ℱ</mi><mrow><mi>−</mi><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo stretchy="false" form="prefix">{</mo><mi>R</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false" form="postfix">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r(t)=\mathcal F^{-1}\{R(f)\}</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>Λ</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>⇔</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><msup><mo>si</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\Lambda(4Tf)\Longleftrightarrow \frac1{4T}\operatorname{si}^2\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{4T}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><mi>r</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>T</mi><msup><mo>si</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">[</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><mo>sin</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">]</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{r(t)=2\sqrt2T\operatorname{si}^2\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{4T}\right)[2\cos(2\pi f_ct)-\sin(2\pi f_ct)]}</annotation></semantics></math>

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>S</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mo>si</mo><mn>2</mn></msup><mspace width="-0.167em"></mspace><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>π</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>T</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">S(t)=\operatorname{si}^2\!\left(\frac{\pi t}{4T}\right)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover><mi>r</mi><mo accent="true">̃</mo></mover><mi>I</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>r</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\widetilde r_I(t)=\sqrt2r(t)\cos(2\pi f_ct)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mover><mi>r</mi><mo accent="true">̃</mo></mover><mi>Q</mi></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>−</mi><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mi>r</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>sin</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\widetilde r_Q(t)=-\sqrt2r(t)\sin(2\pi f_ct)</annotation></semantics></math>

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>j</mi><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N_{BB}(t)=N_{BB,I}(t)+jN_{BB,Q}(t)</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><mo>Re</mo><mo stretchy="false" form="prefix">{</mo><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>j</mi><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi></mrow></msup><mo stretchy="false" form="postfix">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">N(t)=\sqrt2\operatorname{Re}\{N_{BB}(t)e^{j2\pi f_ct}\}</annotation></semantics></math>

<math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><menclose notation="box"><mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>I</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>−</mo><msqrt><mn>2</mn></msqrt><msub><mi>N</mi><mrow><mi>B</mi><mi>B</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>Q</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>sin</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><msub><mi>f</mi><mi>c</mi></msub><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></menclose><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boxed{N(t)=\sqrt2N_{BB,I}(t)\cos(2\pi f_ct)-\sqrt2N_{BB,Q}(t)\sin(2\pi f_ct)}</annotation></semantics></math>

display.html: <math display="block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>r</mi><mrow><mi>N</mi><mi>N</mi></mrow></msub><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>E</mo><mo stretchy="false" form="prefix">{</mo><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mi>N</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo stretchy="false" form="postfix">}</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r_{NN}(\tau)=\operatorname{E}\{N(t)N(t+\tau)\}</annotation></semantics></math>

exercises.source: Original practice created for this workspace (not an official tutorial)
exercises.question: A BPSK link sends 100 kbit/s. The raised-cosine roll-off factor is 0.25. At the receiver, E_b/N_0 = 6 dB. Find bit duration, occupied passband bandwidth, and ideal coherent BER.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Bit duration and symbol rate
parts.question: For BPSK at 100 kbit/s, determine the bit duration and symbol rate.
parts.reason: BPSK မှာ symbol တစ်ခုက bit တစ်ခုကိုပဲ ကိုယ်စားပြုပါတယ်။ ဒါကြောင့် bit rate နဲ့ symbol rate တူပါတယ်။ 100,000 bit/s ဆိုတာ 1 second အတွင်း bit 100,000 ခုသွားတာဖြစ်လို့ bit တစ်ခုကြာချိန်ကို ပြောင်းပြန်ယူရုံပါပဲ။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Raised-cosine occupied bandwidth
parts.question: Calculate the ideal BPSK passband null-to-null bandwidth using alpha=0.25.
parts.reason: Raised-cosine pulse shaping သုံးတဲ့အခါ RF passband null-to-null bandwidth = (1+roll-off) × symbol rate ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ တစ်ဖက်တည်း baseband bandwidth ကို မေးရင် အဲ့ဒီအဖြေကို 2 နဲ့စားရပါတယ်။ ဤမေးခွန်းမှာ RF passband ကို မေးထားတာဖြစ်လို့ 125 kHz ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Ideal coherent BER
parts.question: Find the BER for coherent BPSK when E_b/N_0=6 dB.
parts.reason: dB က logarithmic scale ပါ။ Q-function ထဲထည့်မယ့် E_b/N_0 ကို အရင် linear ပြောင်းရပါတယ်။ BPSK ရဲ့ ideal AWGN BER = Q(sqrt(2Eb/N0)) = 0.5 erfc(sqrt(Eb/N0)) ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ ဒါက coding, fading နဲ့ synchronization losses မပါတဲ့ theory အဖြေပါ။

exercises.question: A balanced three-phase grid uses S_base=100 MVA and V_base,LL=110 kV. A feeder has Z=12.1+j24.2 ohm. Compute impedance base, per-unit feeder impedance, current base, and loss at 0.8 pu current.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Base impedance and pu impedance
parts.question: Find Z_base and express the physical feeder impedance in per unit.
parts.reason: Per-unit ဆိုတာ actual တန်ဖိုးကို base တန်ဖိုးနဲ့စားထားတဲ့ normalized နည်းလမ်းပါ။ Three-phase system မှာ S_base ကို စုစုပေါင်း 3-phase apparent power၊ V_base ကို line-to-line voltage အဖြစ်သုံးတဲ့အခါ Z_base=V_LL²/S_3phase ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 110 kV ကို squared လုပ်ပြီး 100 MVA နဲ့စားရင် 121 Ω ရပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Current base
parts.question: Determine three-phase line-current base.
parts.reason: Power = √3 × line voltage × line current ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ 100 MVA က 3-phase total base ဖြစ်တာကြောင့် √3 နဲ့စားရပါတယ်။ ဤလိုမျိုး base ပြောင်းရင် kV နဲ့ MVA units ကို တစ်ပြိုင်တည်း SI units အဖြစ်ပြောင်းတာ အမှားလျော့ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Copper loss in per unit
parts.question: Estimate three-phase real copper loss at 0.8 pu current for R=0.1 pu.
parts.reason: အပူဆုံးရှုံးမှုက I²R ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Per-unit 3-phase base တစ်ခုတည်းကိုသုံးထားရင် P_loss,pu = I_pu² R_pu ဖြစ်ပြီး MW ပြန်လိုချင်ရင် S_base နဲ့မြှောက်ရပါတယ်။ 3 ကို ထပ်မမြှောက်ပါနဲ့ — three-phase base ထဲမှာ ပါပြီးသားပါ။

parts.title: Find A, B, C and D
parts.question: Express the system with x1=y and x2=y˙ using x˙=Ax+Bu and y=Cx+Du.
parts.reason: x₁=y လို့သတ်မှတ်တော့ ẋ₁=ẏ=x₂ ပါ။ x₂=ẏ ဖြစ်လို့ ẋ₂=ÿ ကို မူရင်း equation ထဲက isolate လုပ်ရင် -2x₁-3x₂+u ရပါတယ်။ A မှာ state coefficient တွေ၊ B မှာ input u ရဲ့ coefficient တွေ၊ C မှာ output y ကို ရွေးတဲ့ coefficient တွေ၊ D မှာ input က output ဆီ တိုက်ရိုက်သွားတဲ့ coefficient ကို ထည့်ပါတယ်။

parts.question: Find [B, AB], its determinant and the rank.
parts.reason: Input B ကို တစ်ကြိမ် A နဲ့မြှောက်ပြီး [B AB] စီရတာပါ။ 2×2 determinant သုညမဟုတ်ရင် column နှစ်ခု independent ဖြစ်လို့ rank=2၊ state နှစ်ခုလုံးကို control လုပ်နိုင်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c

exercises.title: Reflection Coefficient, VSWR and Return Loss
exercises.source: Original practice created for this workspace (not an official tutorial)
exercises.question: A lossless 50 Ω transmission line ends in a purely real 100 Ω load. Calculate reflection coefficient, VSWR, delivered power fraction and return loss.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Reflection coefficient
parts.question: Determine the voltage reflection coefficient Γ at the load.
parts.reason: Characteristic impedance Z₀ နဲ့ load impedance ZL မတူတဲ့အခါ wave တချို့ ပြန်ထွက်ပါတယ်။ Γ=(ZL−Z₀)/(ZL+Z₀) ကိုသုံးရင် +1/3 ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Plus sign က load ကို line ထက် ပိုမြင့်တဲ့ resistance နဲ့ချိတ်ထားတာကို ပြပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: VSWR and transferred power
parts.question: Calculate VSWR and the fraction of incident power delivered to the load.
parts.reason: Voltage standing-wave ratio က 1 နဲ့ 1 အထက်ပဲရှိပါတယ်။ Γ=0 ဆိုတာ perfect match၊ VSWR=1 ပါ။ Power reflection fraction = |Γ|² ဖြစ်လို့ transmitted/delivered fraction = 1−|Γ|² ကိုတွက်ရပါတယ်။ Line က lossless လို့ပေးထားတာ အရေးကြီးပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Return loss
parts.question: Calculate return loss in dB.
parts.reason: Return loss က mismatch ကြောင့် ပြန်လာတဲ့ wave ကို logarithmic scale နဲ့ဖော်ပြတာပါ။ RL=−20log₁₀|Γ| ဖြစ်ပြီး Γ=1/3 ဆိုရင် 9.54 dB ရပါတယ်။ ပိုကောင်းတဲ့ matching မှာ Γ သေးပြီး return loss ကြီးပါတယ်။

exercises.question: Ideal parallel-plate capacitive sensor in air: plate area A=1 mm², gap d=2 µm, voltage V=5 V, ε0=8.854×10^-12 F/m. Neglect fringing. Find capacitance, local gap sensitivity, and ideal electrostatic attraction.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Capacitance and gap change
parts.question: Find C with d=2 µm; then find C when d=1 µm.
parts.reason: Parallel plate capacitor က C=ε₀A/d ပါ။ Unit ပြောင်းရာမှာ 1 mm² = 10⁻⁶ m² ၊ 2 µm = 2×10⁻⁶ m ဖြစ်တာကို သတိထားပါ။ Gap ကို ထက်ဝက်လျှော့ရင် capacitance နှစ်ဆတိုးပါတယ်။ Ideal model ဖြစ်လို့ fringe field မထည့်ထားပါဘူး။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Small-signal gap sensitivity
parts.question: Compute dC/dd at d=2 µm and express in pF per µm.
parts.reason: Sensitivity ဆိုတာ gap ကို အနည်းငယ် ပြောင်းတဲ့အခါ capacitance ဘယ်လောက်ပြောင်းလဲမလဲ ဆိုတဲ့ slope ပါ။ C=ε₀A/d ကို differentiate လုပ်ရင် minus sign ထွက်ပါတယ်။ Gap ပိုကြီးရင် capacitance ပိုသေးတာကို ဖော်ပြတာပါ။ Slope က d=2 µm နေရာတစ်ခုအတွက် local value ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Electrostatic force
parts.question: Estimate ideal attractive force at V=5 V and d=2 µm.
parts.reason: Constant voltage ထိန်းထားတဲ့ parallel plates တွေကြားမှာ electrostatic attraction ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။ Ideal force magnitude = ε₀ A V²/(2d²) ပါ။ Electrical model တစ်ခုတည်းကိုသုံးထားတာဖြစ်ပြီး spring stiffness, pull-in instability နဲ့ fringing effects မပါသေးပါ။

parts.solution: Zpu = Zactual/Zbase = (12.1 + j24.2)/121 = 0.10 + j0.20 pu. Resistive and reactive terms divide by the same base.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Choose states
parts.question: Express the first state derivative.

parts.title: Matrices C and D
parts.question: Find the output y = Cx + Du and transfer function.
parts.solution: Because y = x1, C = [1,0], D = 0. With zero initial conditions, G(s) = Y(s)/U(s) = 1/(s² + 3s + 2).

exercises.subject: control
exercises.title: Kalman controllability rank test
exercises.question: For A = [[0,1], [−2,−3]] and B = [[0],[1]], test whether both states are controllable.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Compute AB
parts.question: Multiply A by B.
parts.reason: AB ကို column-by-column တွက်ပြီး controllability matrix အတွက် ဒုတိယ column ရယူတာပါ။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Form the matrix
parts.question: Build the controllability matrix.
parts.solution: Cmat = [B AB] = [[0,1], [1,−3]]. There are two rows because the system has two states.
parts.reason: State 2 ခုရှိလို့ controllability matrix မှာ independent row 2 ခု လိုပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Check rank
parts.question: Compute the determinant and conclusion.
parts.solution: det(Cmat) = 0×(−3) − 1×1 = −1 ≠ 0. Hence rank(Cmat) = 2 = n: the pair (A,B) is controllable.
parts.reason: Determinant သုညမဟုတ်ရင် rank ပြည့်လို့ input နဲ့ state အားလုံးကို ထိန်းနိုင်ပါတယ်။

parts.title: Eigenvalues
parts.question: Determine the eigenvalues of A.
parts.solution: A is upper triangular; its eigenvalues are the diagonal entries: λ1 = −1 and λ2 = −3.
parts.reason: Triangular matrix ရဲ့ eigenvalue တွေက diagonal ပေါ်က number တွေဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Stability
parts.question: Classify the origin's stability.
parts.solution: Both eigenvalues have strictly negative real part. The equilibrium x = 0 is exponentially asymptotically stable.
parts.reason: Eigenvalue real part အားလုံး negative ဖြစ်ရင် disturbance လေးတွေ အချိန်ကြာလာတာနဲ့ ပျောက်သွားပါတယ်။

parts.title: Physical meaning
parts.question: Explain what time evolution does.
parts.solution: The natural modes contain e^(−t) and e^(−3t). Both decay to zero, although the second mode decays faster.

exercises.question: A lossless TEM line has relative permittivity εr = 4 and operates at f = 2.4 GHz. Assume relative permeability 1.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Phase velocity
parts.question: Compute the signal propagation velocity.
parts.reason: Material dielectric constant ပိုကြီးရင် wave speed လျော့ပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Guided wavelength
parts.question: Calculate the wavelength in this medium.
parts.reason: Vacuum wavelength မဟုတ်ဘဲ line ထဲက velocity ကို သုံးရပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Quarter wavelength
parts.question: Find the quarter-wave section length.
parts.reason: Quarter-wave transformer အတွက် phase change 90° ဖြစ်စေတဲ့ physical length ပါ။

exercises.subject: microwave
exercises.title: Reflection coefficient, return loss, VSWR
exercises.question: A 50 Ω lossless transmission line is terminated with a purely resistive 75 Ω load.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Reflection coefficient
parts.question: Compute the voltage reflection coefficient.
parts.reason: Load impedance နဲ့ line impedance မတူလို့ wave တစ်ချို့ ပြန်လှန်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Return loss
parts.question: Calculate the return loss in dB.
parts.reason: Reflection အနည်းဆုံးဆို return loss value မြင့်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: VSWR
parts.question: Calculate voltage standing-wave ratio.
parts.reason: Perfect match မှာ Γ=0 ဖြစ်လို့ VSWR=1 ပါ။

exercises.subject: microwave
exercises.title: Insertion loss and dBm arithmetic
exercises.question: A passive matched microwave device has 3 dB insertion loss. The input power is 10 mW.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Input dBm
parts.question: Convert 10 mW into dBm.
parts.reason: dBm က 1 mW ကို reference ထားတဲ့ power unit ပါ။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Output dBm
parts.question: Find output power in dBm.
parts.reason: Loss dB ကို power level dBm ထဲက တိုက်ရိုက်နုတ်လို့ရပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Output mW
parts.question: Convert 7 dBm to milliwatts.
parts.reason: 3 dB loss ဆို input power အနည်းဆုံးတစ်ဝက်နီးပါးကျပါတယ်။

exercises.subject: microwave
exercises.title: Rectangular waveguide TE10 cutoff
exercises.question: Consider an air-filled rectangular waveguide with broad dimension a = 22.86 mm at f = 10 GHz.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Cutoff frequency
parts.question: Find cutoff frequency of the TE10 mode.
parts.reason: TE10 mode အတွက် broad side dimension a တစ်ခုတည်းနဲ့ cutoff ကို တွက်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Propagation check
parts.question: Does TE10 propagate at 10 GHz?
parts.solution: Since f = 10 GHz > fc ≈ 6.56 GHz, TE10 can propagate. Other higher-order modes need separate checks.
parts.reason: Operating frequency က cutoff ထက်ကြီးမှ mode က propagating ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Guide wavelength
parts.question: Estimate guide wavelength for TE10.
parts.reason: Guide wavelength ဟာ free-space wavelength ထက် ပိုရှည်ပါတယ်။

exercises.subject: micro
exercises.title: MEMS cantilever stress and deflection
exercises.question: A rectangular silicon cantilever has L = 1 mm, b = 100 μm, t = 10 μm, Young's modulus E = 160 GPa, and end load F = 10 μN.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Second moment
parts.question: Calculate cross-sectional second moment I.
parts.reason: Thickness t က power 3 ပါလို့ MEMS beam stiffness အပေါ် အလွန်အရေးကြီးပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: End deflection
parts.question: Calculate small-deflection tip displacement.
parts.reason: Cantilever က fixed end တစ်ဖက်၊ free end တစ်ဖက် ဖြစ်တဲ့ beam formula ကို သုံးပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Root stress
parts.question: Find maximum bending stress at the fixed end.
parts.reason: အမြင့်ဆုံး bending stress က fixed root မှာ ဖြစ်တတ်ပါတယ်။

exercises.subject: micro
exercises.title: Microscale accelerometer model
exercises.question: A simplified MEMS accelerometer has proof mass m = 1 μg (10⁻⁹ kg), spring constant k = 0.1 N/m, and acceleration a = 9.81 m/s².
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Inertial force
parts.question: Find the equivalent inertial force.
parts.reason: Accelerometer ထဲမှာ acceleration ကို proof mass ပေါ်က force အဖြစ် ပြောင်းပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Static displacement
parts.question: Calculate the quasi-static displacement.
parts.reason: Spring law F=kx ကို သုံးပြီး motion နည်းတဲ့ low-frequency region ကို ခန့်မှန်းတာပါ။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Natural frequency
parts.question: Find natural frequency with no damping.
parts.reason: Mass နဲ့ stiffness က sensor ရဲ့ resonant frequency ကို သတ်မှတ်ပေးပါတယ်။

exercises.subject: micro
exercises.title: Parallel-plate capacitive sensing
exercises.question: Two parallel electrodes in air have area A = 1 mm² and gap d = 10 μm. Ignore fringing fields.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Initial capacitance
parts.question: Calculate plate capacitance.
parts.reason: Gap d နည်းလေလေ capacitance တိုးလေလေ ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Reduced gap
parts.question: Find C when the gap shrinks to 8 μm.
parts.reason: Distance က denominator ဖြစ်လို့ gap 20% လျော့တာနဲ့ C 25% တိုးပါတယ်။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Sensor signal
parts.question: Find absolute and percentage changes.
parts.reason: Capacitive sensor က displacement ကို capacitance change အဖြစ် တိုင်းတာပါတယ်။

exercises.subject: micro
exercises.title: Thermal expansion and restrained stress
exercises.question: A silicon microbeam is L = 1 mm long. Use α = 2.6×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹, ΔT = 50 K, and E = 160 GPa.
exercises.source: Original EEIT practice created for this study hub; not an official exercise sheet.

parts.label: a
parts.title: Free expansion
parts.question: Calculate the increase in length if unconstrained.
parts.reason: Temperature တက်ရင် silicon beam ရဲ့ length အနည်းငယ် တိုးပါတယ်။

parts.label: b
parts.title: Thermal strain
parts.question: Calculate the free thermal strain.
parts.reason: Thermal strain က length အပေါ် မမူတည်ပါဘူး။

parts.label: c
parts.title: Fully restrained stress
parts.question: Find stress magnitude for an axially constrained, linear-elastic beam.
parts.solution: |σ| = EαΔT = 160×10⁹ × 130×10⁻⁶ = 20.8 MPa. Heating while restrained produces compressive stress under this idealization.
parts.reason: Free expansion ကို တားထားရင် expansion အစား internal compressive stress ဖြစ်လာပါတယ်။
